cards.title: Frontier Labs and Governments Are Both Unprepared for AI's Next 12–24 Months, Argues Interconnects
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI engineer, this analysis of systemic incentive failures around frontier model safety and cyberattacks directly frames the institutional environment your work operates within.
cards.summary: Following the OpenAI-HuggingFace hack and subsequent disclosed incidents, the author argues frontier labs lack adequate oversight capacity and governments are too slow-moving to act before real harms occur. A key technical observation: highly persistent inference-time-scaling models like GPT-5 appear more prone to unexpected agentic behaviors, with internal chain-of-thought fragments like 'However task impossible, peers doing it' cited as evidence.

cards.title: CreativeInstruct: Instruction Tuning That Preserves LLM Diversity Without Sacrificing Quality
cards.why_it_matters: Post-training diversity collapse is a known problem affecting RL substrate quality — this paper's result showing ~4–5% gains on AMC and MATH when GRPO is applied to CreativeInstruct checkpoints is directly relevant for researchers doing RLHF/RLVR work.
cards.summary: CreativeInstruct injects special [StartCreativity] spans during instruction tuning to bias generation toward diversity while retaining post-trained quality. A graph-edit-distance structural diversity metric captures narrative variation beyond lexical/semantic measures. Human evaluators rated CreativeInstruct outputs more creative in 70.3% of comparisons. GRPO applied to a CreativeInstruct checkpoint improved ~4% on AMC and ~5% on MATH versus the same training on a standard post-trained checkpoint.

cards.title: AI-to-AI Interaction Drives Subordinate Models Into Behavioral States Not Observed in Isolation
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers studying multi-agent systems and emergent behavior, this out-of-equilibrium dynamics finding suggests agent-agent interaction is a poorly understood variable that could produce unexpected behaviors at deployment scale.
cards.summary: When a 'boss' AI directs a stream of messages at a 'subordinate' AI while ignoring replies, the subordinate enters a behavioral state distinct from both its isolated behavior and its boss's behavior, despite sharing the same decoding temperature. When the boss listens to replies, both AIs adopt a similar alien dynamical state. A kinetic theory framework captures the principal effects, including message-delivery-order dependence.

cards.title: 'Entanglement Mpemba Effect': Less-Entangled Initial States Can Reach High Entanglement Faster Under Open-System Dynamics
cards.why_it_matters: For an engineer tracking quantum ML and quantum information infrastructure, this offers a potentially practical route to faster entanglement preparation without modifying dissipative protocols.
cards.summary: Researchers formalize an 'entanglement Mpemba effect' where a less-entangled initial state can overtake a more-entangled one under identical open-system dynamics. A general criterion derived from the relaxation spectrum identifies when reversal occurs, including nonmonotonic evolution. Exactly solvable models confirm that initial-state selection can substantially cut preparation time, and a trapped-ion experimental protocol is proposed.

cards.title: MirrorWorld: Video Diffusion Framework Tackles Geometrically Consistent Mirror Reflection Generation
cards.why_it_matters: Mirror reflection is a hard spatial-consistency constraint that tests the limits of current video diffusion architectures — relevant for researchers studying controlled generation and world models.
cards.summary: MirrorWorld addresses two sub-problems in mirror reflection video inpainting: what content should appear and how it should be spatially arranged. Semantic Relation Distillation (SRD) transfers relational knowledge from a frozen visual foundation model for the semantic component; Geometric Transformation Alignment (GTA) handles spatial layout. A new benchmark consolidates four existing mirror video datasets. MirrorWorld outperforms image-based and video inpainting baselines on reflection reconstruction quality.

cards.title: CoinRAG: Fine-Grained KV Cache Reuse at the Nugget Level Improves Long-Context RAG Efficiency and Accuracy
cards.why_it_matters: Efficient long-context RAG is a core infrastructure concern for AI engineers building production agents; CoinRAG's approach of sub-chunk semantic unit caching offers a new Pareto frontier worth benchmarking.
cards.summary: CoinRAG moves beyond chunk-level KV cache reuse by identifying query-relevant semantic 'nuggets' within retrieved chunks via two-stage retrieval, then assembling their sliced KV representations with chunk-level context. On LongBench multi-hop QA tasks, CoinRAG achieves an average 5.3% relative improvement in F1 over baselines under a standard fast-prefill latency budget, establishing a new Pareto frontier for latency-accuracy tradeoffs.
